To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) molecular dynamics simulations predict the specificity of corticosteroid action, and (2) the most specific corticosteroids have the least flexible steroid rings, which are therefore more likely to adopt the conformation needed for receptor binding.
“Steroid specificity is determined by a combination of structural and functional factors, and the most specific steroids are the most rigid”.
molecular dynamics simulations of corticosteroids correlate with biological activity, and that this approach may be used for ligand–receptors in general.

the molecular basis of biological specificity, using a novel computational approach to identify structural features that determine biological function.
the design of novel drugs for treating diseases, including cancer, and the development of novel diagnostic tools.
the development of computational tools for the analysis and interpretation of biological data, with particular reference to drug discovery.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
molecular dynamics simulations are able to predict activity of a series of steroids with high specificity.
the conformational flexibility of the steroid molecule, as well as the flexibility of the protein receptor, is important for the specificity of steroid hormone action.
the conformational mobility of the corticosteroid ligands determines the specificity and potency of these ligands in binding to the mineralocorticoid receptor and glucocorticoid receptor.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the corticosteroid specificity is determined by the conformational flexibility of the steroid ring.
a steroid's biological specificity is determined by its conformational mobility.
the corticosteroid binding globulin (CBG) is the most specific receptor, while the mineralocorticoid receptor is less specific, and the glucocorticoid receptor the most promiscuous of the three.
The main takeaway from our work is that
molecular dynamics can help in understanding how structural features determine the biological activity of steroids.
molecular flexibility can be a useful guide in the design and discovery of new drugs, and that the use of computational methods can help in the design and interpretation of experiments.
the conformational dynamics of ligands are an important factor in determining their biological specificity.
